title.ja: Noun を あげる (Noun wo ageru)

explanation.en: The を あげる grammar point is used to express giving something to someone. It can be translated as 'give', 'offer', or 'present' in English. This construction is commonly used with nouns to indicate giving or offering a tangible item, action, or favor to someone else.

examples.english: I gave flowers to my friend.
I will give a watch to my father.

examples.japanese: 彼女に手紙をあげたい。
examples.english: I want to give her a letter.
